markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
The conformal set holds one class, and the second model and 5/5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly peaked |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 64th percentile | Typical input [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors agree [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma here [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; concept model reads absence as favoring invasive · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Scored high, but failed AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 7, 9) · context · Above typical; descriptive only, spot check borderline [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated JPEG degradation (severity 3) distorts texture; the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration is imprecise: ECE 0.05 (95% CI 0.03–0.18) on a small test set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 4, 8** — confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma; these score highest for that feature.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 11** — lateral margin called tumor-positive [F7]; region 7 has the lowest invasive probability.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 4** — count mitoses directly; the model's mitosis score failed its spot check.
